# 2 Baruch Chapter 58 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 58:2 — yoke of slavery formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-yoke-of-bondage" |
| LOGOS | "the yoke of bondage" |
| PNEUMA | "the yoke of slavery" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Bondage' (Syriac: 'abduta) is the standard Exodus-tradition term; 'slavery' is synonymous but 'bondage' preserves the covenantal/legal register of the source.
